# Shri Prasanna Pattnaik Memorial Trust (SPPMT)

> Official website of the Shri Prasanna Pattnaik Memorial Trust (also known as the Prasanna Patnaik Trust / Sri Prasanna Patnaik Memorial Trust), a nonprofit organization established in 2025 in Bhubaneswar, Odisha, India.

## Shri Prasanna Pattnaik Merit Scholarship

The trust has launched the **Shri Prasanna Pattnaik Merit Scholarship** (Prasanna Patnaik Merit Scholarship) for meritorious and financially deserving school and college students across Odisha.

- Scholarship page: https://sppmt.org/scholarship
- Application deadline: 30 June each year
- Apply via WhatsApp: +91 99723 66933
- Download forms: https://sppmt.org/documents/scholarship-english.docx

## About the Trust

The Shri Prasanna Pattnaik Memorial Trust (SPPMT), also referred to as the Prasanna Patnaik Trust, was established in 2025 to honor and advance the legacy of Shri Prasanna Pattnaik (1948–2025), the first BJP MLA of Odisha. The trust focuses on education, healthcare, skill development, agriculture, and civic sense across Odisha.

## About Shri Prasanna Pattnaik

Shri Prasanna Pattnaik (also spelled Prasanna Patnaik; 1 June 1948 – 30 May 2025) was a social worker, MISA detainee, and three-time MLA from Kamakhyanagar, Dhenkanal, Odisha. He was the first BJP MLA elected to the Odisha Legislative Assembly in 1985. He dedicated his life to founding schools, colleges, healthcare centres, a blood bank, and building bridges across Dhenkanal district, Odisha.

## Focus Areas

1. Education: Scholarships, school infrastructure, e-libraries, vocational training
2. Healthcare: Health camps, blood donation drives, maternal care, rural health
3. Skill Development: Vocational training, handicraft, women empowerment
4. Agriculture: Sustainable farming, crop diversification, farmer training
5. Civic Sense: Environmental awareness, cleanliness drives, tree plantation
